detail.title: 4MP WizColor Fixed-focal Bullet WizMind Network Camera
detail.overview: New Compare Favourite IPC-HFW4439M-AS-PV-B-PRO 4MP WizColor Fixed-focal Bullet WizMind Network Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 4 MP Resolution • Exceptional Image Quality in Low-Light Environments by WizColor Technology • Xinghan Vision Models: Comprehensive Enhancement of Target Detection, Imaging • Deep Learning-Based Human and Vehicle Classification • Built-in Mic & Speaker: Secure Real-Time Talk Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Illumination Distance: Up to 20 m (65.62 ft) (Warm light);Up to 30 m (98.43 ft) (Warm light)
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Intrusion, tripwire (the two functions support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human)
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by the sub stream)
General.AI Coding: AI H.265; AI H.264 (Super AI Coding) *Includes smart codec technology, Smart H.265+ and Smart H.264+
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 2688 × 1520@(1–20/30 fps)/2560 × 1440 (1–30 fps) Sub stream: 704 × 576@(1–25 fps)/704 × 480@(1–30 fps) Third stream: 352 × 288@1 fps/352 × 240@1 fps *The values above are the max frame rates of each stream; for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity.
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 24 kbps–4096 kbps H.265: 9 kbps–4096 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; motion detection; video tampering; tripwire; intrusion; audio detection; voltage detection; external alarm; SMD; security exception
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; P2P; Auto Registration
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S & Profile G & Profile T); CGI
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (supports max 512 GB)
General.Browser: IE: IE 11 and later Chrome: Chrome 102 and later Firefox: Firefox 88 and later
General.Management Software: SmartPSS Lite; DSS; DMSS; DoLynk Care
General.Security: Session security;Digest; WSSE; Account lockout; Trusted execution; Generation and importing of X.509 certification; 802.1x; Security logs; Security warning; IP/MAC filtering; HTTPS; Trusted upgrade; syslog; AES 256; SSL/TLS1.2; Trusted boot
General.Light Warning: Warm light warning Flash/Solid on duration: 5 s–30 s Flash frequency: high, medium, low
General.Sound Warning: Offers 3 sound alarms and supports importing custom sound alarms. Sound: 0–100. Play times can be set from 1 to 10.
General.Certifications: CE-LVD: EN62368-1 CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU
General.Alarm Input: 1 channel in: supports wet contact connection (max load 5 mA 3–5 VDC); supports dry contact connection
General.Alarm Output: 1 channel out: wet contact, max load 300 mA 12 VDC
General.Dual Power Backup: When the power adapter and PoE provide power at the same time, disconnect one of them. The device will continue to work, but will not restart.
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 1.9 W (12 VDC); 3.7 W (PoE) Max (Intelligence on + WDR + illuminator intensity): 6.7 W (12 VDC); 11.5 W (PoE)
General.Anti-corrosion Level: Basic Protection *The products are designed for general use and are applicable even in areas with no specific requirements for anti-corrosion protection.
General.Casing Material: Front casing: Metal Back casing: Plastic
